judgment_refs.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_refs.note: Blueprint identity does not prove authorization or agency role.

judgment_refs.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_refs.note: Original motion or driver-visible indication must be reviewed; no numeric speed defines preparation.

judgment_refs.phrase: flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_refs.note: Native lamp readback and original pixels require independent equipment review.

judgment_refs.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_refs.note: Officer identity, direction, recipient and timing need original sources.
Brake response and stopping distance are engineering observations, not a legal readiness threshold.
Original camera evidence and actor geometry must establish sight line.

judgment_refs.phrase: use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle
judgment_refs.note: A separate source-driver hand signal and its visibility remain to be constructed and reviewed.

sweep_specs.rationale: The response pair is built; full physical alternatives and source qualification still require separate cases.
missing_inputs: Original vehicle/lamp authority and pixel review; visible preparation, hand signal and officer direction constructions remain pending.

cases.rationale: Shared semantic comparison reference; no separate capture.
